name: Being A Good Leader
overview: Scripture reveals that being a good leader involves aligning one’s ways to please the Lord, which brings peace even with adversaries, and trusting God to direct each step despite human plans. True leadership is marked by humility and service, as Jesus contrasts worldly rulers who exercise authority with His call to serve others. Confidence in God’s strength and help sustains leaders in their responsibilities, while treating others with the same respect and kindness one desires reflects the heart of godly leadership. Recognizing Christ as Master and Lord sets the ultimate example for those who lead.
